name: CPU LM Speed Benchmark
description: Benchmark base LMs (10M–1B) on CPU — speed and quality

paragraphs: Enter any base causal language model on the Hub with between 10M and 1B parameters and this Space benchmarks it on CPU: it measures prefill speed (prompt tokens / second) AND decoding speed (generated tokens / second) at every rung of a prompt-length ladder — 64, 256, 1024, 4096 and 11264 tokens (median of 3 timed runs per length up to 1024, one warm-up run discarded; 2 timed runs without warm-up above 1024) — and measures perplexity on a fixed 20×512-token slice of the WikiText-2 raw test set as a quality score.
Results are stored as JSON in the public bucket FlameF0X/lm-cpu-benchmarks — one file per model — and the Leaderboard tab reads them all, with a filter by model size.

the entry check: detection uses the model card's basemodel metadata plus name patterns (instruct, chat, sft, dpo, …), and the leaderboard also hides already-stored entries that match. This board compares architectures' raw speed and coherence, not fine-tuning effort.
